findings.description: Maria Bracero, born about 1883, married Gregorio Morales, born about 1849 and the son of Tomas Morales and Leonarda Bracero, on 23 June 1907; the marriage was registered in the civil register of Mayagüez, Puerto Rico.
supporting_sources: Puerto Rico, Registro Civil, 1805-2002 — marriage entry for Gregorio Morales and Maria Bracero, 23 Jun 1907

findings.description: Maria Bracero's parents were Juan Bracero and Juana Irizarri, per the same marriage entry.
supporting_sources: Puerto Rico, Registro Civil, 1805-2002 — marriage entry for Gregorio Morales and Maria Bracero, 23 Jun 1907, naming her parents Juan Bracero and Juana Irizarri
